def process(load_csn_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_csn_data.dropna(how='all')
    df_2024 = df[df['Year'] == 2024].copy()
    return df_2024

def process(extract_2024_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    row = extract_2024_data.iloc[0]
    
    fraud = int(str(row['Fraud ']).replace(',', ''))
    identity_theft = int(str(row['Identity Theft ']).replace(',', ''))
    other = int(str(row['Other ']).replace(',', ''))
    
    total = fraud + identity_theft + other
    fraud_percentage = round(100 * fraud / total)
    
    result = pd.DataFrame({
        'Metric': ['Total Reports', 'Fraud Reports', 'Fraud Percentage'],
        'Value': [total, fraud, fraud_percentage]
    })
    return result
